name: Continuous Coarse-To-Fine Optimization
definition: A progressive optimization strategy that avoids shape-radiance ambiguity by restricting the Level of Detail (LOD) to coarse levels initially, then relaxing this regularization to recover scene details. It operates continuously in LOD space rather than discretely.
summary: Continuous Coarse-To-Fine Optimization is a progressive training strategy that mitigates ambiguity by gradually increasing scene resolution, distinguishing itself by operating continuously in LOD space without modifying previously trained parameters.
